3 p. 'tunnelling AMR'. Second instance of the traction-vs-payload semantic error: DB max_payload 2000 is the 'Rated Traction Capacity'; the sheet publishes no payload row and the vehicle has a tow pin. Raises a product_type question (AMR per the manufacturer vs Tugger per the machine), which decides which AP0 fields are even in scope.

6 p. reach truck VNR14(V)-01, no DB row. At 1400 kg / 8555 mm it out-reaches both the heavier VNR16 (5500 mm) and VNR20 (7000 mm), which casts doubt on those two stored lift heights.

Model-code suffix decodes the navigation package: (V)=vision, (VL)=vision+3D laser, (VM)=vision+magnetic. MODEL-CODE COLLISION: VNR16(V)-07 and VNR25(V)-07 each appear TWICE on physically different machines, disambiguated only by the operator-station page subtitle.

NOT the same machine as the catalog's VNT20(V)-07 despite both being 2 t / ~115 mm pallet jacks. Source of the 'charging efficiency 1C' charge_time trap and the sub-degree drop_accuracy_angle finding.
